parts: Hi All: I have tried to run example 5 from the bilogmg manual but get error message e.g, NA/NaN.  There is only 2 items overlapping group 1 and group 2 and similarly there is only two items overlappig group 2 and group 3.  Maybe it is trying to tell me that there is not enough common information in such an unrealistic example.  The strange thing is Bil;ogmg encounters no problems and yields what appear to be reasonable estimates of item parameters.and group means.
